_note: The rules for every kind of thing in the game. Each class lists its own fields and inherits its parent's. Order of defaults: the field's default here, then the data file's defaults, then the entry itself. Types: string, int, number, bool, color, list<string>, list<int>, materials (material id -> count), map (string -> string), enum (see values). An entry whose kind differs from its file's class uses kind_classes to pick its class.

id.doc: Unique snake_case id. Saves refer to it, so never rename one that has shipped.

kind.doc: Set by the class; only override for special cases (bee, barn).

unlock_level.doc: Level that unlocks it. 99 = never in the Market (earned, traded or starter only).

color.doc: Main colour of the code-drawn placeholder.

status.doc: planned = in the catalog for reference only; the game doesn't load it, and only id and name are required.

note.doc: Anything a developer should know about this entry.

family.doc: Set by the loader: the family it's listed under.

category.doc: Set by the loader: the catalog file it's in.

Crop.doc: Planted in plowed plots, harvested when ripe.

flower.doc: Flower harvests can bring bees and Queen Bees.

Material.doc: Building materials that drop while farming.

basic.doc: Basic materials always drop; others only once you own something that uses them.

gem_cost.doc: Gems in the Market instead of coins.

Producer.doc: Placeables that are collected every cycle.

product.doc: What it gives, as shown to the player.

rare_sapling.doc: The rare variety an Orchard can sprout from this tree.

rare_of.doc: For a rare variety: the tree it sprouts from.

Animal.doc: Animals, loose on the farm or inside their home.

breed.doc: Chicken breed for Mystery Eggs (white, brown, red, grey, black, golden).

stray_only.doc: Only wanders in as a stray; never bought.

home.doc: For strays: the building the player must own before it can appear.

rare_pig.doc: A rare breed traded for truffles at the Pig Pen.

Building.doc: Holds animals, trees or vehicles; may be built from a frame and expanded.

levels.doc: Capacity at each size, smallest first.

level_names.doc: Name at each size (e.g. Coop, Big Coop, Huge Coop).

holds.doc: Item ids that can move in.

holds_kind.doc: Any item of this kind can move in.

one_each.doc: Specials kept one at a time, taking no space (a bull, a ram).

build_materials.doc: If set, it arrives as a frame finished with these.

uses_materials.doc: Materials that start dropping once you own it.

special.doc: Its FarmVille extra on each collection.

produces.doc: false = never ready to collect (the Garage).

grow_days.doc: Nursery: days for a baby to grow up.

Barn.doc: The starter barn: broken until repaired, then storage.

Vehicle.doc: Works an area of plots per tap and burns fuel.

job.doc: What it does to each plot.

upgrade_parts.doc: Vehicle Parts for each Garage upgrade (2x2 to 3x2, 3x3, 4x3, 4x4).

upgrade_levels.doc: Player level each upgrade needs; same length as upgrade_parts.

build_materials.doc: If set, it arrives as a chassis finished with these.

build_xp.doc: XP when the chassis is finished.

shape.doc: Placeholder drawing (fence, hedge, haybale, ...). Starter scenery is drawn by id instead.

variant.doc: Shape variant (pine, oak, willow for shade trees).

layout: Each data file: {class, _note, defaults, families: [{id, name, doc, defaults, variants: [entries]}]}. Category = file, family = a group of variants sharing defaults (Cows: Cow, Bull, Calf).
